reviews.text: My aunt recommended me this place and I’m so glad she did! I had a wonderful experience bringing in my two young cats. Dr. Marta Petryna and staff were super helpful, listened to my cats symptoms, and answered all my questions and concerns. She was very thorough with the exams. At the end we got a nice goody bag full of toys, treats, and informative paperwork! I will definitely recommend all my friends and family to come here!

Dr. Katie and the staff are nothing short of wonderful. We adopted a senior pet in May and decided to establish care here based in reviews and location. Dr. Katie met with us and was so kind and patient and talked through all of my worries due to his age and lack of sight/hearing. The staff were helpful any time I needed some input from the provider or medication refills. With a senior pet the decline can happen so quickly so the additional supporteant everything. Today the time came for our boy and they were accommodating, kind, supportive and genuinely cared about how difficult the end can be. We are so fortunate to have found Dr. Katie and Mayfair. When we inevitably get another pup Mayfair will absolutely be our vet again. Thank you all so much for your love and guidance.

Diagnosed my family’s dog with diabetes and did not start him on insulin right away for whatever reason. They said “let’s just monitor the situation”. A week and a half later my family’s dog died because he started going into a diabetic coma. Do not take your sick animals here if you want them to live a long life. They hold off on life saving treatments. Cruel and irresponsible decisions are made by the vets here.

I have owned dogs all my 60 year old life and have visited many veterinary clinics.  Mayfair Animal Clinic was the friendliest , most thorough, and caring clinic I have ever used.
I love that they are family owned and not part of some nationwide chain. They were also reasonably priced.  The vet, Dr. Fedyniaks, who examined my dog was loving and honest about the services I needed or didn’t need.
About service
Have been there years ago And They are Still the Most Compassionate and Reasonably priced Hospital  nurses Far..
Mayfair is a wonderful and warm place that truly cares about both animals and their humans. Highly recommended!
Great vet. Best care for your animals in the Chicago area
The care and support is the best anywhere.   Big thanks to Lisa, Sam, and Brian for treating and making my puppy well..      Chris O.  Breeder

I’m so grateful we found Mayfair Animal Clinic. They truly care about your pets like they’re their own and have been incredible throughout my dog’s health issues this past year. It’s one of the few vets left that still feels personal and genuinely family owned, and you can absolutely feel the difference because of it. I really hope they never change. Their prices are extremely reasonable compared to surrounding vets as well.

Dr. Sam, Dr. Elizabeth, and all of the techs have been amazing. I recommend this clinic to so many friends and clients, and every single person who has transferred their pet’s care here has had nothing but great things to say.

We just had our first dental cleaning under anesthesia yesterday and Dr. Sam was much more thorough than our previous vet (and faster!).
Thank you to the entire team for being so kind, patient, and so caring, even with my very spicy chihuahua 🥲❤️

We've enjoyed our experience so far and really like Dr. Sam. They were even able to accommodate our rescue dog who is anxious at the vet even on all the meds. They have fair price transparency and lay out options thoughtfully.
Nice people, great facility. Very communicative and organized. No complaints here.

My cat got sick. Really, really sick. The folks at Mayfair were great with her, very acommodating and flexible with appointments, incredibly kind and empathetic. Dr. Paul did a great job setting forth all the options and then discussing what options he thought were most worthwhile, most cost effective, and would actually affect treatment plans. He referred us to the emergency vet for some urgent surgery but was in full communication with them and took over her post-op care. I couldn't ask for better care from a vet. I also love that they're a family owned local business!

Very professional, very nice . I had my cat put to sleep very understanding.
Gave me his fur a clay of his paw .
Wonderful experience
The clinic staff and vet were extremely informative and gentle during my fur baby's visit, where they administered routine well checks and exams.
After going to a couple other vets, i can tell they both care about and take great care of my cats.
Great care for my 3 cats! This is an independent vet practice, not part of a chain, which is great.

I have been to many vets all around the Chicago area for my dogs and cats, and I trust none of them on the level I trust Mayfair Animal Clinic. The quality of care, affordability, and transparency are a cut above the rest. This isn't a corporate vet, this is a warm, family run business. I have had fantastic experiences with Dr. Paul and Dr. Elizabeth. All the vet techs and receptionist are kind, friendly and willing to answer any questions they can. The veterinary work Dr. Paul specifically has done has visibly and dramatically improved the lives of my pets. I could not recommend a vet more.

The Mayfair staff was fantastic. The techs were so sweet to my dog that she actually wasn’t as afraid. Dr. Hadley is the best!  We love her kind interaction with the animals and she explains everything you need to know. Highly recommend!

Avoid Mayfair Animal Clinic — especially Dr. Elizabeth. In my experience, she was completely unresponsive, lacked compassion, and repeatedly failed to follow up on urgent medical issues. She didn’t even provide test results when they became available, and my pet’s condition worsened because of these delays. I had to call over and over just to get basic information she had promised to share.
Based on my experience, she should not be caring for animals. I regret ever bringing my pet here and strongly urge others to go elsewhere.
The staff here is amazing.  They always treat my doggies so nice and gentle. And always so friendly to myself as well!  I recommend 100%

First time cat owner, with an adopted cat and her first vet visit!

Was very happy with my experience and happy I chose to establish treatment at Mayfair.
They are a great place that treats you when animals with respect
Friendly and responsive staff. They got us in quickly, knew how to work with an anxious dog, and included my kids in the process. Thank you for helping Lola through her ear infection!
We have no record of you coming to our clinic.

Our 7 year old lab had been going here since he was a puppy. He had severe allergy issues and had tried all sorts of medications. They informed us switching his diet was the best course of action. He was put on a limited ingredient diet. This happened approximately 4 years ago. Walter was diagnosed last week with dilated cardiomyopathy & congestive heart failure due to this type of food. The hospital told us this research has been published since 2018 with an association of grain-free diets and dilated cardiomyopathy. We were never informed of these risks. The hospital told us his murmur was audible and had been progressing for years. I would not recommend Mayfair due to their lack of knowledge and assessment skills. I called to inform them of Walter’s severe diagnosis and they never called me back.
Amazing doctors and staff! Absolutely should be your choice for your pet's health, your human sanity, and you get to support a local, family-owner business!

Have been going for almost a decade for yearly checkups and vacations for my dog. Staff is knowledgeable and caring with my shy pup.  Love that I can walk there but they also have a small parking lot too. Only negative is that I feel they may be on the higher end of price but have not shopped around.
Dr. Elizabeth is wonderful
I want to gatekeep this place but they do such a good job I have to leave a review. Have been coming here for decades for all my pets, staff here is very sweet and kind.

This clinic truly stands out! From the moment you walk in, every staff member greets you with genuine kindness and care. We’ve been seeing Dr. Winkler, and she is exceptional—always thorough, patient, and dedicated to ensuring I fully understand every part of my pup’s health. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for top-notch vet care in a warm, welcoming environment!

Just called to set an appointment based on all the positive reviews.  I was told that they woukd not schedule with me and I need to call back Monday at 9am to set an appointment and they weren't sure of availability.  I respect that this place is doing good business, but on a customer service level this seems pretty backwards.  It looks like I'm goin elsewhere for 10+ years of dog care.
They are very knowledgeable and kind. I have a senior cat with diabetes and kidney disease, and they know just how to handle her and explain everything to us.
Very kind vet miss Kate was awesome with my kitty ok time wise too
So caring for a my fur baby afraid of some people but wanted her to feel comfortable by taking a minute to introduce themselves
Great experience visiting for the first time. They treated my cat amazingly and really listened to all my concerns. I’m so glad to have found a new vet for my little one just minutes away.
Always A+ care and customer service. Don’t hesitate!
Called to schedule an appointment for my dog and was told they are not accepting new patients and to call back and the 8/26.
Very friendly place.  Always good service and very clean.  They have a  parking lot.
